entries.title: Matthew 23:1
segments: Then spake Jesus to the multitudes and to his disciples,

entries.title: Matthew 23:2
segments: saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit on Moses seat:

entries.title: Matthew 23:3
segments: all things therefore whatsoever they bid you, [these] do and observe: but do not ye after their works; for they say, and do not.

entries.title: Matthew 23:4
segments: Yea, they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men's shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with their finger.

entries.title: Matthew 23:5
segments: But all their works they do to be seen of men: for they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders [of their garments],

entries.title: Matthew 23:6
segments: and love the chief place at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,

entries.title: Matthew 23:7
segments: and the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called of men, Rabbi.

entries.title: Matthew 23:8
segments: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your teacher, and all ye are brethren.

entries.title: Matthew 23:9
segments: And call no man your father on the earth: for one is your Father, [even] he who is in heaven.

entries.title: Matthew 23:10
segments: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your master, [even] the Christ.

entries.title: Matthew 23:11
segments: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.

entries.title: Matthew 23:12
segments: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be humbled; and whosoever shall humble himself shall be exalted.

entries.title: Matthew 23:13
segments: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye shut the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye enter not in yourselves, neither suffer ye them that are entering in to enter[.]

entries.title: Matthew 23:14
segments: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows' houses, even while for a pretence ye make long prayers: therefore ye shall receive greater condemnation.

entries.title: Matthew 23:15
segments: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he is become so, ye make him twofold more a son of hell than yourselves.

entries.title: Matthew 23:16
segments: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, that say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor.

entries.title: Matthew 23:17
segments: Ye fools and blind: for which is greater, the gold, or the temple that hath sanctified the gold?

entries.title: Matthew 23:18
segments: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gift that is upon it, he is a debtor.

entries.title: Matthew 23:19
segments: Ye blind: for which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?

entries.title: Matthew 23:20
segments: He therefore that sweareth by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.

entries.title: Matthew 23:21
segments: And he that sweareth by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.

entries.title: Matthew 23:22
segments: And he that sweareth by the heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.

entries.title: Matthew 23:23
segments: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye tithe mint and anise and cummin, and have left undone the weightier matters of the law, justice, and mercy, and faith: but these ye ought to have done, and not to have left the other undone.

entries.title: Matthew 23:24
segments: Ye blind guides, that strain out the gnat, and swallow the camel!

entries.title: Matthew 23:25
segments: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full from extortion and excess.

entries.title: Matthew 23:26
segments: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first the inside of the cup and of the platter, that the outside thereof may become clean also.

entries.title: Matthew 23:27
segments: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men's bones, and of all uncleanness.

entries.title: Matthew 23:28
segments: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but inwardly ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

entries.title: Matthew 23:29
segments: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and garnish the tombs of the righteous,

entries.title: Matthew 23:30
segments: and say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we should not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.

entries.title: Matthew 23:31
segments: Wherefore ye witness to yourselves, that ye are sons of them that slew the prophets.

entries.title: Matthew 23:32
segments: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.

entries.title: Matthew 23:33
segments: Ye serpents, ye offspring of vipers, how shall ye escape the judgment of hell?

entries.title: Matthew 23:34
segments: Therefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: some of them shall ye kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute from city to city:

entries.title: Matthew 23:35
segments: that upon you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of Abel the righteous unto the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah, whom ye slew between the sanctuary and the altar.

entries.title: Matthew 23:36
segments: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.

entries.title: Matthew 23:37
segments: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, that killeth the prophets, and stoneth them that are sent unto her! how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!

entries.title: Matthew 23:38
segments: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.

entries.title: Matthew 23:39
segments: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed [is] he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
